A small Japanese factory
that has spent seventy years
on the pedal.
MKS(미카시마 제작소, 三ヶ島製作所)는 1950년 일본 사이타마현 도코: MKS (Mikashima Industrial, 三ヶ島製作所) is a specialist bicycle pedal maker founded in 1950 in Tokorozawa, Saitama, Japan. Not frames, not wheels, not a whole groupset: MKS has focused on the pedal alone, and still makes its pedals in its own factory in Tokorozawa.
MKS의 페달은 화려하지 않습니다. 대신 정확하게 가공된 바디와 스핀들,: MKS pedals are not flashy. Instead they have precisely machined bodies and spindles, hand-adjusted cup-and-cone bearings, and a construction you can still take apart and rebuild decades later. That is why MKS has long been the default choice on classic road and touring bikes, fixed gears and everyday bicycles.
일본 도코로자와에서 시작된 페달 제조사: A pedal maker founded in Tokorozawa, Japan
자체 공장에서 가공하고 조립하는 페달: Pedals machined and assembled in its own factory
일본 경륜(케이린) 규격의 트랙 페달을 만드는 제조사: A maker of track pedals to the Japanese keirin standard
Made in Tokorozawa.
Pedals built to last.
페달은 자전거에서 가장 많이 밟히고, 가장 자주 부딪히는 부품입니다. M: The pedal is the part of a bicycle that is stepped on most and knocked most often. So MKS makes pedals not as consumables but as parts you service and keep using: open the bearings, repack the grease, replace only what is worn, tighten them up and ride again.
경륜 선수들의 트랙 페달에서 출발한 정밀함은 투어링 페달과 도시용 플랫: The precision that began with track pedals for keirin racers carries straight through to touring pedals and city flat pedals. It is why Japanese bicycle craftsmen and classic bike builders around the world choose MKS.
바디와 스핀들을 자체 공장에서 가공합니다. 오차가 적은 부품은 오래 써도: Bodies and spindles are machined in our own factory. Parts made to tight tolerances stay free of play for years.
볼 베어링을 손으로 조절하는 전통 구조. 분해하고 그리스를 채워 다시 조: The traditional hand-adjusted ball bearing. Take it apart, repack the grease and adjust it again.
일본 경륜의 엄격한 NJS 규격을 통과한 트랙 페달을 만들어 온 경험이: Experience from making track pedals that pass the strict NJS standard of Japanese keirin goes into every pedal.
클래식 로드부터 미니벨로, 출퇴근 자전거까지. 어떤 자전거에도 자연스럽게: From classic road bikes to minivelos and commuters. A shape that looks natural on any bicycle.
도쿄에서 멀지 않은 도코로자와. MKS는 이곳에서 70년 넘게 페달만 만: Tokorozawa, not far from Tokyo. MKS has made nothing but pedals here for more than seventy years.
MKS는 한 가지 부품에 오래 집중해 온 일본 제조업의 전형 같은 회사입: MKS is a textbook Japanese manufacturer, devoted to a single component for a very long time. New models arrive, but the basic construction barely changes, and an MKS pedal bought long ago can be serviced the same way.
쿼일 페달과 토클립의 시대부터 넓은 플랫 페달과 퀵 릴리스 시스템까지,: From the era of quill pedals and toe clips to wide flat pedals and quick-release systems, the MKS range has grown with the way bicycles are used. The principle stays the same: pedals that spin well, last long and can be repaired.
From classic road to the city commute, the right pedal for your bike.
토클립과 함께 쓰는 클래식 로드 쿼일 페달. 빈티지 로드와 픽스드 기어의: Classic road quill pedal used with toe clips. The standard for vintage road and fixed gear.
Touring quill pedal you can ride on either side. The Sylvan that is comfortable in regular shoes.
트랙과 픽스드 기어를 위한 날렵한 실반. 토클립과 스트랩을 단단히 잡아줍: A sleek Sylvan for track and fixed gear. Holds toe clips and straps securely.
발바닥 전체를 받치는 넓은 양면 플랫폼. 긴 투어링과 일상 라이딩을 위한: Wide double-sided platform that supports the whole foot. For long tours and everyday riding.
도시와 일상을 위한 플랫 페달과 블록 페달. 운동화, 구두 어떤 신발로도: Flat and block pedals for the city and every day. In trainers, dress shoes, anything.
공구 없이 페달을 떼고 끼우는 MKS의 퀵 릴리스 시스템. 접이식 자전거: MKS's quick-release system for removing and fitting pedals without tools. For folding bikes and storage.
The pedal that suits
classic bicycles best.
Sylvan.
실반(Sylvan)은 MKS를 대표하는 쿼일 페달입니다. 얇은 금속 케이: Sylvan is MKS's signature quill pedal: thin metal cages support the shoe, with the body and spindle running between them in the traditional way. It looks most at home on vintage road bikes, randonneurs and fixed gears.
쓰임에 따라 로드, 투어링, 트랙 세 가지로 나뉩니다. 로드와 트랙은 토: It comes in three versions by use: Road, Touring and Track. Road and Track are single-sided pedals used with toe clips and straps, while Touring can be ridden on either side, making it easy in regular shoes. All three have serviceable cup-and-cone bearings.
토클립을 달 수 있는 탭이 있는 클래식 로드 페달. 빈티지 로드 자전거를: Classic road pedal with a tab for toe clips. The first Sylvan riders reach for when restoring a vintage road bike or building one in classic style.
양면 케이지로 어느 쪽이든 밟을 수 있는 투어링 페달. 운동화로 타는 랜: Touring pedal with double-sided cages, so you can step on either side. Suits randonneurs ridden in trainers, touring bikes and everyday bikes.
트랙과 픽스드 기어를 위한 날렵한 실반. 토클립과 스트랩으로 발을 단단히: A sleek Sylvan for track and fixed gear. Toe clips and straps hold the foot firmly, transferring both push and pull straight to the pedal.
토클립과 함께 완성되는 페달: A pedal completed by toe clips
실반 로드와 트랙은 토클립과 스트랩을 함께 쓸 때 진가를 발휘합니다. 발: Sylvan Road and Track come into their own with toe clips and straps. The foot sits in the same place on the pedal every time, and you can use both the push and the pull. MKS also makes toe clips to match its pedals.
클립리스 페달이 흔해진 지금도 실반과 토클립의 조합을 고르는 라이더가 많: Even now that clipless pedals are common, many riders choose Sylvans with toe clips. You can ride in regular shoes, and they keep the bicycle's silhouette clean.
클래식 로드, 투어링, 트랙, 픽스드 기어: Classic road, touring, track, fixed gear
A pedal you step on
with your whole foot.
Comfortable all the way.
Lambda is a double-sided platform pedal that supports the whole sole of the foot. The contact area is wide and gently raised in the middle, so even on long rides in regular shoes without clips, pressure never concentrates on one point. In the US it is also known as the Grip King.
장거리 투어링과 바이크패킹, 매일의 출퇴근까지. 클립리스 슈즈를 신지 않: Long-distance touring, bikepacking and the daily commute. It is the first pedal MKS recommends to riders who do not wear clipless shoes.
발바닥 전체를 받치는 넓은 면. 힘이 고르게 나뉘어 긴 라이딩에서도 발이: A broad surface that supports the whole foot. Load is spread evenly, so feet stay comfortable on long rides.
앞뒤 어느 면으로도 밟을 수 있어 출발과 정차가 잦은 도시 라이딩에서도: Either side can be stepped on, so it is easy in stop-and-go city riding.
운동화, 하이킹 슈즈, 구두까지. 표면의 패턴이 신발 밑창을 안정적으로: Trainers, hiking shoes, even dress shoes. The surface pattern holds the sole securely.
MKS의 다른 페달처럼 베어링을 열어 정비할 수 있습니다. 오래 탈수록: Like other MKS pedals, the bearings can be opened and serviced. The longer you ride, the more it shows.
Flat pedals
for city bicycles.
In any shoes.
출퇴근 자전거와 미니벨로, 접이식 자전거, 장보러 가는 자전거. 매일 타: Commuters, minivelos, folding bikes, the bike you take to the shops. A bike you ride every day needs pedals that work with any shoe, are easy to step onto and last. The MKS city line is made for those bicycles.
깔끔한 양면 플랫 페달 올웨이즈(Allways), 도시용으로 단정하게 다: Allways, a clean double-sided flat pedal; US-B, neatly refined for the city; and GR-9, a classic with rubber blocks. The shapes differ, but the MKS bearings and finish are the same.
매일 쓰는 자전거를 위한 양면 플랫 페달. 단정한 모양과 넓은 발판으로: A double-sided flat pedal for the bike you use every day. Its tidy shape and wide platform suit any bicycle.
도시 라이딩을 위해 다듬은 플랫 페달. 미니벨로와 시티 바이크에 가볍고: A flat pedal refined for city riding. Light and clean on minivelos and city bikes.
고무 블록을 끼운 클래식 블록 페달. 구두나 가죽 밑창도 미끄러지지 않고: A classic block pedal with rubber blocks. Dress shoes and leather soles do not slip, and it feels soft underfoot.
매일 타는 자전거일수록<br/>좋은 페달을:
The more you ride a bike,
the better its pedals should be
페달은 자전거에서 몸이 닿는 세 곳 중 하나입니다. 안장과 핸들만큼 페달: The pedal is one of the three places your body touches the bicycle. Change the pedals, as with the saddle and bars, and the whole bike feels different: bearings that spin smoothly, a platform that does not slip, a construction that does not work loose over time.
MKS의 시티 페달은 EZY 버전으로도 만들어져, 접이식 자전거를 접거나: MKS city pedals also come in EZY versions, so you can take the pedals off when folding a bike or storing it in a tight space. Please ask Rubi Workshop which models are available in EZY.
Pedals that come off
and go back on without tools.
EZY.
EZY는 MKS가 만든 페달 퀵 릴리스 시스템입니다. 크랭크에 전용 어댑: EZY is MKS's quick-release pedal system. With a dedicated adapter fitted to the crank, the pedal can be pulled off and refitted by hand without tools. To fit it, just push it in until it locks; to remove it, pull back the sleeve.
접이식 자전거를 더 작게 접을 때, 자동차나 기차에 자전거를 실을 때,: When folding a bike smaller, loading it into a car or train, or storing it in a narrow hallway or on a wall, the pedals no longer stick out. One pair of adapters also lets you swap between several EZY pedals.
크랭크에 EZY 어댑터를 한 번만 달아 둡니다. 일반 페달과 같은 방식으: Fit the EZY adapter to the crank once, the same way you would fit a normal pedal.
페달을 어댑터에 밀어 넣으면 딸깍하고 잠깁니다. 라이딩 중에는 단단히 고: Push the pedal into the adapter and it clicks into place, held firmly while you ride.
Pull back the sleeve and the pedal comes off. No tools, no force.
크랭크 어댑터 + EZY 전용 페달, 공구 없는 탈착: Crank adapter + EZY pedal, tool-free removal

MKS 페달은 대부분 일반 3피스 크랭크의 9/16인치 규격입니다. 아동: Most MKS pedals use the standard 9/16 inch thread of 3-piece cranks. Children's bikes and some one-piece cranks (1/2 inch) use a different thread, so please check before fitting. If you are not sure which model suits your bike, send Rubi Workshop a photo of it.
한 가지 부품을<br/>오래, 잘 만드는 일.<br/>MKS가 걸어온 길:
Making one component
well, for a long time.
The MKS story.
전후 일본의 자전거 산업이 다시 일어서던 1950년, 미카시마 제작소는: In 1950, as Japan's post-war bicycle industry was getting back on its feet, Mikashima Industrial began making pedals in Tokorozawa. Track pedals for Japanese keirin, the Sylvan for classic road, the Lambda for touring, flat pedals and EZY for the city. The history of MKS has moved with the changes in Japanese cycling culture.
사이타마현 도코로자와에서 미카시마 제작소가 문을 엽니다. 처음부터 자전거: Mikashima Industrial opens in Tokorozawa, Saitama. Bicycle pedals are at its heart from the start.
일본 경륜의 NJS 규격 트랙 페달을 만들며, 선수들의 엄격한 기준에 맞: Making NJS-standard track pedals for Japanese keirin builds precision that meets racers' strict demands.
로드, 투어링, 트랙의 실반 시리즈가 MKS를 대표하는 페달이 되고, 전: The Sylvan series for road, touring and track becomes MKS's signature pedal and a standard for classic bicycles worldwide.
일반 신발로 멀리 가는 라이더를 위한 넓은 플랫폼 페달 람다가 투어링 라: Lambda, a wide platform pedal for riders who go far in regular shoes, wins the hearts of touring cyclists.
공구 없이 페달을 떼고 끼우는 EZY 시스템으로 접이식 자전거와 도시의: The EZY system for removing and fitting pedals without tools brings new convenience to folding and city bikes.
